description: The CREST Demand Model is an integrated thermal-electrical model of domestic energy demand with a bottom-up, activity-based structure, stochastic representation of dwelling diversity, and reduced-order thermal-electrical networks for thermal dynamics, calibrated and validated to give high-resolution output. It was developed as free open-source software to promote transparency and further research, and is distributed as macro-enabled Excel workbooks. Versions were uploaded from 2015 to 2020; version 2.3 added Indian households, and version 2.3.3 of 15 May 2020 fixed minor bugs in 2.3 and 2.3.1. Coverage: UK dwellings, with an Indian household option. Access: free Excel workbooks from the Loughborough repository, DOI 10.17028/rd.lboro.2001129.v8. Licence: GPL 3.0 or later. Caveats: it runs in Excel VBA and results can depend on the Excel version. Simulation uses: synthetic minute-level household demand for distribution network, heat pump and PV studies. Related records: the Cambridge Housing Model and BREDEM.
